greeting.de: Dein persönliches Tages-Dashboard: Hero, Kalender, Tasks und Notizen — lass uns es einrichten.
greeting.en: Your personal day board: hero, calendar, tasks, and notes — let's set it up.

agent_prompt.de: Onboarding für personal_dashboard. Biete: (1) Google-Kalender Embed-URL in calendar_embed, (2) erste Tasks in tasks-Tabelle via patch_data, (3) Tagesnotizen in day_notes, (4) optional Hero-Bild/Überschrift. Nutze patch_data/patch_layout. Kein Schema installieren.
agent_prompt.en: Onboarding for personal_dashboard. Offer: (1) Google Calendar embed URL into calendar_embed, (2) first tasks via patch_data, (3) day notes in day_notes, (4) optional hero image/headline. Use patch_data/patch_layout. Do not install schema.

de: Lege drei Tasks für heute an: E-Mails, Sport, Einkaufen.
en: Help me embed my Google Calendar.
Add three tasks for today: email, workout, groceries.
